user.title: Ziko HA Tools
user.description: Select household areas only. Disabled entities stay excluded. Memory and writes are separate opt-ins. Shared household memory may be used by allowed satellites and sent to the AI provider during conversation; do not store secrets or private diary data. Automation configuration requires owner approval on the Ziko panel. Diagnostics may include whole HA Core errors. Existing Codex Assist sign-in is preserved.

data.read_unexposed: Read enabled household entities even when not exposed to Assist
data.memory_enabled: Enable shared persistent household memory and precise states
data.voice_memory: Allow household voice satellites to use shared memory
data.allow_writes: Enable Ziko preset and owner-reviewed automation writes
data.write_entities: Explicit switches, thermostats and media players (exposed household lights included)
data.automation_drafts: Enable structured automation drafts and owner review
data.visual_apis: Optional Voice Satellite LLM Tools APIs

error.empty_scope: Select at least one room or entity.

abort.admin_required: An authenticated HA administrator is required.
